board.name: finvizp
board.description: Implementation of the frozen public Finviz client roadmap through 1.0

common_rules: Read the normative foundation spec, decision register, public-surface inventory, source ledger, linked plan section, and parent handoffs before acting.
Run the relevant full repository gates; bounded live probes supplement but never replace fixtures.
Never tag, publish, create a release, automate login, bypass access controls, crawl the site, or expose secrets/proxy URLs.
implementation_rules: Fetch origin and ensure the worktree branch starts from current origin/main.
Use strict vertical RED-GREEN-REFACTOR TDD; record the exact expected RED and actual GREEN commands.
Keep changes within the listed ownership scope; do not edit central manifests/exports unless the card owns them.
Commit, push the unique branch, open a PR, then call kanban_request_review with reviewer=reviewer and structured evidence.
Reviewer requests changes on the same card or merges the PR and verifies merged main/CI before kanban_complete.
audit_rules: Inspect clean current origin/main and parent handoffs independently; do not implement findings in the audit card.
Create focused remediation cards for findings and keep the audit blocked until they merge.
Complete only with an explicit verdict and merged-main/CI evidence.
gate_rules: Do no implementation work. Remain blocked with kind=needs_input until the user explicitly approves starting implementation.
On explicit approval, complete this gate manually so the dependency graph can promote the first implementation card.

cards.title: gate: approve finvizp implementation start
cards.objective: Hold the entire implementation graph until the user explicitly approves starting code implementation.
cards.acceptance: Complete manually only after explicit user approval. No code, branch, PR, tag, release, or publication.

cards.title: 0.1: immutable results, errors, symbols, and sync bridge
cards.objective: Implement frozen result/error contracts, safe redaction, symbol normalization, and event-loop-safe sync execution.
cards.acceptance: All contract invariants, redaction, class-share normalization, dedupe/order, and active-loop rejection are RED-first tested; full gates pass.

cards.title: 0.1: versioned schemas and Arrow normalization
cards.objective: Create deterministic registry-driven Arrow schemas and source-near value normalization.
cards.acceptance: Empty schemas, fractions/base units, nulls, dates/timestamps, raw companions, extra_fields, warnings, and strict_schema are RED-first tested; full gates pass.

cards.title: 0.1: classified FinvizClient transport
cards.objective: Implement the fastreq-backed lifecycle, route/proxy/auth isolation, hashing, retries, and typed response classification.
cards.acceptance: Inspect actual fastreq interfaces first; fake-transport tests cover lifecycle, proxy precedence, auth isolation, 403/429/Elite/not-found/timeout/5xx, cancellation, redaction, and no unsolicited output.

cards.title: 0.1: parsed-result cache and single-flight
cards.objective: Add parsed immutable result caching, bounded LRU eviction, stale policy, and concurrent miss coalescing.
cards.acceptance: Cache key isolation, TTL/refresh/disable, provenance, explicit stale-if-error, eviction, cancellation, and one-underlying-call single-flight are RED-first tested; full gates pass.

cards.title: 0.1: symbol universe manifest and ranked search
cards.objective: Implement one-request stock-manifest symbols and bounded JSON suggestions without following entries.
cards.acceptance: Namespaced XML, ty=oc dedupe, dash forms, unexpected URLs, deterministic order, no URL following, ranked suggestions, empty/drift, sync/cache behavior, and bounded live evidence pass.

cards.title: 0.1: six public JSON statement forms
cards.objective: Implement IA/IQ/BA/BQ/CA/CQ as long deterministic Arrow tables from public JSON.
cards.acceptance: All statement codes, currency/period/value parsing, raw values, batch order, strict/partial/all-fail, cancellation, empty/drift, cache/sync, and bounded live evidence pass.

cards.title: 0.1: complete stock-page QuoteBundle parser
cards.objective: Parse all six snapshot tables and every verified stock-page relation into an immutable QuoteBundle.
cards.acceptance: All snapshot regions, reordered structures, every relation, temporal raw/status, fingerprints, optional/required drift, extra_fields, bundle immutability, and empty schemas are RED-first tested.

cards.title: 0.1: quote batching and cache-preserving projections
cards.objective: Expose quote async/sync operations, multi-symbol semantics, and projections that never refetch the stock page.
cards.acceptance: Canonical/fallback routes, one-fetch bundle, order/dedupe/safety, strict/partial/all-fail/cancel, projection provenance, no refetch, and sync behavior pass.

cards.title: 0.1: integrate capabilities, exports, docs, and live smokes

cards.acceptance: Manifest integrity/imports, curated exports, docs, empirical conservative defaults, Python 3.11-3.14, build/Twine, and bounded symbols/statements/quote smokes pass on merged behavior.
